placementRules.notes: Session 48 runtime-style correction of v001. Canvas dimensions, silhouette bounding box, footprint and pivot are BIT-IDENTICAL to v001 (only alpha cleanup and RGB tone/texture were touched, no crop or resize), so the Session 46 measured geometry in EDGE_PROP_DEFS (game.js) carries over unchanged - no placement/road-intrusion values were retuned. minSpacing and placementWeight stay 0 for the same reason as v001: no procedural pool exists, this record must not enter a runtime pool on its own.

notes: PAB-MUMBAI-ENVPROP-VADA-PAV-CART-V1, Session 48 runtime-style correction pilot. Source: v001 binary (mumbai_prop_vadapav_cart_fixed_canopy_right_neutral_1x_v001.png), corrected via a deterministic local pipeline (scipy/opencv/PIL) - no re-generation, no redesign. Alpha: removed the baked ground-contact shadow and 9,534 sub-alpha-8 dust pixels by keeping only alpha>=200 core plus a 4px dilation (real antialiasing fringe), zeroing everything else; measured alpha>=32 bbox is IDENTICAL before/after (226,431)-(949,1056), so EDGE_PROP_DEFS visualBounds/footprint/cropSafe/pivot in game.js needed no changes. Style: cv2.pyrMeanShiftFiltering (sp=18, sr=45) flattened painterly gradients into broader colour regions, followed by a light bilateral pass and PIL contrast x0.78 / saturation x0.75 / brightness x1.06. Measured effect: Laplacian-std texture 61.6->46.0 (-25%), greyscale contrast std 57.8->43.7 (-24%), mean HSV saturation 136->85 (-38%). Honest limit: this is a raster filter pass, not a re-illustration - it cannot add the bold flat cel-shade outline the existing procedural/hand-drawn game props use (see assets/props/mumbai-day.png), so full stylistic parity with those props still requires re-authoring, not further filtering. Status is 'review' (not 'approved') pending PM sign-off on whether the reduced-but-still-painterly result is good enough to proceed, and pending a night-palette visual call (Test A day passed at runtime; night was checked for readability/no-clash, not a full approval loop). See docs/art-production/PRODUCTION_ASSET_BRIEFS.md and CHANGELOG.md for the Session 48 write-up.
